extracted.name: Pineapple Salsa
extracted.description: Make this easy pineapple salsa for a fresh summer appetizer, or top it onto your favorite Mexican dishes for a sweet and spicy pop of flavor.
instruction_lines: In a medium bowl, combine the pineapple, red onion, jalapeño, lime juice and zest, cilantro, garlic, and sea salt. Season to taste and chill until ready to use.
Serve with tortilla chips. Find additional serving suggestions in the blog post above.
